messages.subject: Scatter between 2 data frames?
parts:
Hi all,

I have 2 data.frames  df1 and df2
sales = c(1,4,3,2,3,4,5,6,7,6,7,5)
 profit = c(4,3,2,3,4,5,6,7,7,7,6,5)
df1 = data.frame(sales=sales,profit=profit)

sales = c(1,4,3,2,3,4,5,6,7,6,7,5)
 profit = c(4,3,2,3,4,5,6,7,7,7,6,5)
df2 = data.frame(sales=sales,profit=profit)

> str(df1)
'data.frame':   12 obs. of  2 variables:
 $ sales : num  1 4 3 2 3 4 5 6 7 6 ...
 $ profit: num  4 3 2 3 4 5 6 7 7 7 ... ##(by the way in my real data I have 30 variables).

I need to plot scatter plot for all variables (in one graph) between df1 and df2 and add R and p-value to the graph. the desired output will be like the attached image:


Has anyone worked on such thing?
Thanks in advance,
Bic

parts:
Hi BicTon,

Please try:

# title: customized multiple scatter plot
# date: 2017.3.8

set.seed(168)
samplesize <- 10
variablessize <- 30

df1 <- as.data.frame(matrix(sample(20, samplesize*variablessize, replace=TRUE), ncol=variablessize))
df2 <- as.data.frame(matrix(sample(20, samplesize*variablessize, replace=TRUE), ncol=variablessize))

usr <- par("usr")
op <- par(mfrow=c(5, 6)) # 5 rows, 6 columns
for (i in 1:ncol(df1)) {
  lms <- lm(df2[,i] ~ df1[,i])
  rsquare <- round(summary(lms)$r.squared, 4)
  pvalue <- round(summary(lms)$coefficients[,4][2], 4)
  plot(df1[,i],df2[,i], main=names(df1[i]), xlab="df1", ylab="df2")
  abline(lms, col="red", lty=2)
  text(min(df1[,i])*1.05, max(df2[,i])*0.9, substitute(paste(R^{2}, " = ", rs), list(rs=rsquare)), adj=c(0,0), cex=1.1)
  text(min(df1[,i])*1.05, max(df2[,i])*0.8, paste0("Pvalue = ", pvalue), adj=c(0,0), cex=1.1)
  
}
par(op)
# end

# end

Hi Bic-Ton,

Please try to use "cor" function.



# title: customized  multiple scatter plot with correlations
# date: 2017.3.9

set.seed(168)
samplesize <- 10
variablessize <- 30

df1 <- as.data.frame(matrix(sample(20, samplesize*variablessize, replace=TRUE), ncol=variablessize))
df2 <- as.data.frame(matrix(sample(20, samplesize*variablessize, replace=TRUE), ncol=variablessize))

usr <- par("usr")
op <- par(mfrow=c(5, 6)) # 5 rows, 6 columns
for (i in 1:ncol(df1)) {
  lms <- lm(df2[,i] ~ df1[,i])

pvalue <- round(summary(lms)$coefficients[,4][2], 4)
  plot(df1[,i],df2[,i], main=names(df1[i]), xlab="df1", ylab="df2")
  abline(lms, col="red", lty=2)

text(min(df1[,i])*1.05, max(df2[,i])*0.9, paste0("R = ", corvalue), adj=c(0,0), cex=1.1)
  text(min(df1[,i])*1.05, max(df2[,i])*0.8, paste0("P-value = ", pvalue), adj=c(0,0), cex=1.1)
  
}
par(op)
# end
